what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from the State of Palestine in Libya: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 392 Palestinian asylum seekers in Libya, 2.3% of all asylum seekers from the State of Palestine.
Refugees from the State of Palestine, a separate group, live mostly in Greece, Belgium, Iraq and Cyprus.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for the State of Palestine, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2021.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 14 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 2853, at the end of 2019, and was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Libya.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Libya only.
